name: duckherd
description: A lead agent that plans and judges, and helper agents that do the work, shown as ducks.

lessonsFile.title: Lessons file
lessonsFile.description: The Markdown file lessons are saved to. ~/ means your home folder.

quickLooks.title: Quick looks per request
quickLooks.description: How many quick looks (Read, Grep, Bash and so on) the lead duck gets before it must hand work to a helper. 0 to 20.

throttleFiveHour.title: Throttle: 5-hour threshold (%)
throttleFiveHour.description: The usage throttle tightens when the 5-hour window is this percent used. 1 to 100. Level 2 comes 10 points later, and not below 90.

throttleWeekMargin.title: Throttle: weekly margin (points)
throttleWeekMargin.description: The throttle tightens when weekly use runs this many points ahead of the pace of the week gone. 0 to 100.

keepWarm.title: Keep-warm default
keepWarm.description: Where keep-warm starts: auto, on or off. /keep-warm changes it and the choice is remembered.

chatEffort.title: Chat effort default
chatEffort.description: The lead duck's own effort at start: auto, off, or a level (low, medium, high, xhigh, max). /chat-effort changes it and the choice is remembered.

cmuxPath.title: cmux command
cmuxPath.description: The cmux command line to use. Leave empty to find it (CMUX_BUNDLED_CLI_PATH, else the usual place). ~/ means your home folder.

sounds.title: Sounds
sounds.description: Whether the ducks' sounds are on at start. /crew on or off changes it and the choice is remembered.

themesDir.title: Themes folder
themesDir.description: A folder of extra themes: NAME.theme.json files, or folders holding duckherd-theme.json. Themes shipped by other installed plugins are found without it. ~/ means your home folder.

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: The theme drawn at start: ducks, or the id of a theme that was found. /crew theme changes it and the choice is remembered.

statusFiles.title: Status files
statusFiles.description: Write a small status file per lead duck to ~/.claude/duckherd/dashboard/ for outside tools. Off by default.
